products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates under the Merative name, offering a portfolio of products aimed at healthcare providers, life sciences organizations, and payers.

Its product lineup includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution providing point-of-care insights to clinicians; Zelta, a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, which includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo noted as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Truven is offered as a health data and analytics product with consulting services, and the company also provides a portfolio focused on real-world evidence studies.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, with noted capabilities spanning healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
